name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez's path to motorsport was unconventional. Initially a mechanical engineering student, she found herself drawn to the practical application of her studies during an internship at a local racing team. The thrill of optimizing performance through rigorous testing ignited a passion that led her away from theoretical design and into the heart of the action. She quickly moved from data analysis to driver support, building a reputation for meticulous preparation and clear communication.

At Sprint V8 Team, Sofia thrives on the pressure of coordinating test programs. She believes in a data-driven approach, ensuring every session yields actionable insights. Her demanding nature stems from a commitment to maximizing the team's resources and pushing drivers to their limits. She fosters a collaborative environment, valuing the input of engineers and mechanics alike, while always keeping the focus on achieving tangible improvements in lap times and overall vehicle performance. Sofia's loyalty is legendary and once she commits to a team, she is in it for the long haul.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often pulled back in a tight bun
physical.description: A petite woman with a focused gaze, Sofia carries herself with an air of quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on starting every testing session with a specific playlist of high-energy Latin music.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
